def test_diagnostic_specs_exports_and_factory():
    import friday_commands.memory_queries as memory_queries_module
    assert api.__all__ == ['PILOT_SPECS', 'SESSION_SPECS', 'CommandArgument', 'CommandError', 'CommandExecution', 'CommandHandler', 'CommandOutcome', 'CommandRegistry', 'CommandRequest', 'CommandSpec', 'DispatchResult', 'ExitData', 'FoundationData', 'HelpCatalog', 'HelpData', 'HistoryData', 'HistoryTurn', 'NoData', 'SessionClearedData', 'SessionPort', 'UiEffect', 'build_pilot_handlers', 'build_session_handlers', 'describe_help', 'DiagnosticField', 'ContextData', 'PromptData', 'DebugTurnData', 'DebugData', 'BudgetData', 'TimingCounter', 'TimingTurnData', 'TimingData', 'RetrievalData', 'RetrievalUnavailableData', 'DIAGNOSTIC_SPECS', 'DiagnosticsPort', 'build_diagnostic_handlers', 'MemoryWarningData', 'MemoryMetricData', 'MemorySectionData', 'MemoryStatisticsData', 'MemoryRecordData', 'MemoryRecordsData', 'MemoryQueryFailedData', 'MemoryUnavailableData', 'GraphEntityData', 'GraphRelationshipData', 'GraphData', 'IngestedDocumentData', 'IngestedDocumentsData', 'MEMORY_QUERY_SPECS', 'MemoryQueryPort', 'build_memory_query_handlers']
    owners = ((contracts, ('CommandArgument', 'CommandError', 'CommandExecution', 'CommandOutcome', 'CommandRequest', 'CommandSpec', 'DispatchResult', 'ExitData', 'FoundationData', 'HelpData', 'HistoryData', 'HistoryTurn', 'NoData', 'SessionClearedData', 'UiEffect', 'DiagnosticField', 'ContextData', 'PromptData', 'DebugTurnData', 'DebugData', 'BudgetData', 'TimingCounter', 'TimingTurnData', 'TimingData', 'RetrievalData', 'RetrievalUnavailableData', 'MemoryWarningData', 'MemoryMetricData', 'MemorySectionData', 'MemoryStatisticsData', 'MemoryRecordData', 'MemoryRecordsData', 'MemoryQueryFailedData', 'MemoryUnavailableData', 'GraphEntityData', 'GraphRelationshipData', 'GraphData', 'IngestedDocumentData', 'IngestedDocumentsData')), (registry_module, ('CommandHandler', 'CommandRegistry')), (pilot_module, ('PILOT_SPECS', 'HelpCatalog', 'build_pilot_handlers', 'describe_help')), (session_module, ('SESSION_SPECS', 'SessionPort', 'build_session_handlers')), (shared, ('DIAGNOSTIC_SPECS', 'DiagnosticsPort', 'build_diagnostic_handlers')), (memory_queries_module, ('MEMORY_QUERY_SPECS', 'MemoryQueryPort', 'build_memory_query_handlers')))
    expected_bindings = {name: getattr(module, name) for module, names in owners for name in names}
    assert len(expected_bindings) == 54
    assert set(expected_bindings) == set(api.__all__)
    for name, expected in expected_bindings.items():
        assert getattr(api, name) is expected, name
    frozen = json.loads((Path(__file__).parent / 'fixtures/diagnostics-metadata.json').read_text())
    metadata = {s.name: asdict(s) for s in DIAGNOSTIC_SPECS}
    assert tuple(metadata) == NAMES
    assert json.dumps(metadata, sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(frozen, sort_keys=True)
    assert type(DIAGNOSTIC_SPECS) is tuple
    with pytest.raises(FrozenInstanceError):
        DIAGNOSTIC_SPECS[0].name = 'changed'
    assert CommandRegistry().names() == frozenset()
    first = build_diagnostic_handlers(NoReads())
    second = build_diagnostic_handlers(NoReads())
    assert type(first) is MappingProxyType
    assert first is not second
    assert tuple(first) == NAMES
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        first['other'] = first['context']
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        isinstance(NoReads(), DiagnosticsPort)
    assert CommandRegistry().names() == frozenset()
